objective: Attack universal finite-C common-EB Dirichlet comparison through tensor and Pauli graph structure

opportunities.title: Sharp common-EB factor two for signed product-qubit channels and tracial sandwiches
opportunities.exact_quantifiers: For every n>=1, D=2^n, finite mixture weights q_r, supplied bistochastic F_r:M_D->M_D, and supplied local unital TP HS-selfadjoint self-compatible qubit CPTP channels Phi_(r,j), let Phi=sum_r q_r F_r^dagger (tensor_j Phi_(r,j)) F_r. There exists one TP unital canonical pure-ensemble EB Psi, independent of the frame, with I-Psi<=2(I-Phi) on the full real Hermitian HS space. Hence every positive frame Q satisfies V(Q)-k(Q)<=2[V(Q)-s_Phi(Q)], with unrestricted pure-ensemble k and barycenter I/D.
opportunities.importance: Removes independent tensor products and their stated tracial closures as mechanisms for accumulating the previously rank-dependent logarithmic comparison loss. It includes entangled observables and correlated graph-encoded channel mixtures while retaining one common comparator.
new_mechanism_in_this_run: Noncommuting operator tensor Bernoulli inequality preserves C>=1 under tensor products of positive HS contractions
Legal absolute-value qubit channel plus filled pure Bloch covariance handles signed factors without losing sign-cancelled global modes
Identity defect I-F^dagger F is positive for a bistochastic channel, so adjoint sandwiches preserve the comparison constant
Spectral refinement of transformed POVM effects restores the pure-ensemble barycenter interface

opportunities.load_bearing_missing_lemma_for_ambitious: A general legal Phi need not have the supplied product/mixture/tracial-sandwich representation. No representability theorem or exact separating nonfactorable sequence was established.
compatibility_obligations: Each local self-compatibility premise is one supplied joint CPTP broadcaster, not merely compatible selected observables
Tensor broadcaster outputs are regrouped into two D-dimensional receivers
Mixtures retain one common random branch and legal equal marginals
Adjoint sandwich uses a bistochastic F, so F^dagger is also TP and unital
The comparator is one full-domain EB channel and the refined pure ensemble retains barycenter I/D
early_falsification_tests: Signed bit-flip dephasing fixes ZZ after tensoring while an arbitrary valid local comparator can erase ZZ; prevents naive signed tensorization
C5 walk has (|S|)_(0,1)=(2-sqrt(5))/10<0; prevents higher-dimensional physical absolute-value transfer
Nine two-qubit weight-two Paulis have product pure score 1 but unrestricted k=3; prevents treating product support as unrestricted support
Rectangular code compression of two clone marginals retains trace 13/18; prevents nontracial isometry transfer without marginal accounting
